title: IOP GWAS eCAVIAR colocalization results
bodyHtml: This table contains the significant eCAVIAR colocalization results for intraocular pressure (IOP) GWAS loci (Khawaja et al., 2018) by QTL type, target gene, and tissue combinations tested across 49 GTEx tissues and peripheral retina. All e/sVariants within an LD interval ((r2<0.1 plus 50kb on either side) around 133 lead GWAS variants were tested in the colocalization analysis. Significance was determined at colocalization posterior probability (CLPP) > 0.01. To filter out potential false positives, we flagged cases where the GWAS p-value of the colocalization e/sVariant was above 1E-05 and/or whose e/sQTL p-value was above 1E-04 or FDR above 0.05 (FALSE in Column: 'Pass QC (QTL FDR<0.05 or P<1E04 and GWAS P<1E05)'). Chromosome positions are in genome build 38. The table was taken from Supplementary Data 9 in Hamel et al., 2024.
